# International Association for Identification

> The IAI is the premier professional organization for forensic identification specialists, providing standards, certification, and resources across multiple forensic disciplines.

Founded by Harry H. Caldwell, the International Association for Identification (IAI) serves forensic science professionals through specialized subcommittees, certification programs, and alignment with standards organizations like OSAC and NIST. The organization maintains headquarters in Hollywood, Florida and hosts annual conferences for member updates and professional development.

## Key Topics

- International Association for Identification (IAI)
- Forensic disciplines
- Certification and standards
- Latent print examination
- Facial identification
- Crime scene investigation
- Bloodstain pattern analysis
- Digital and multimedia evidence
- Biometric technology
- Forensic art
- OSAC standards
- Professional membership
- Footwear and tire track examination
- Forensic photography

## Core Organization

- [Home - International Association for Identification](https://www.theiai.org): IAI homepage with forensic science news, member updates, and conference info
- [IAI History - International Association for Identification](https://www.theiai.org/iai_history.php): IAI organizational history from founding by Harry H. Caldwell
- [Forensic Disciplines - International Association for Identification](https://www.theiai.org/forensic_disciplines.php): IAI forensic disciplines and subcommittees overview
- [Special Committees & Appointments - International Association for Identification](https://www.theiai.org/special_committees_appointme.php): IAI special committees and leadership appointments for 2025-2026

## Forensic Identification Subcommittees

- [Latent Print Development Subcommittee - International Association for Identification](https://www.theiai.org/latent_print_development_subco.php): Latent print development best practices and fingerprint analysis qualifications
- [Facial Identification Subcommittee - International Association for Identification](https://www.theiai.org/facial_identification_subcommi.php): Facial identification and recognition standards for law enforcement examiners
- [Bloodstain Pattern Identification Subcommittee - International Association for Identification](https://www.theiai.org/bloodstain_pattern_identificat.php): Bloodstain pattern analysis standards, certification, and training requirements
- [Biometric Technology Subcommittee - International Association for Identification](https://www.theiai.org/biometric_technology_subcommit.php): Biometric Technology Subcommittee standards and criminal justice applications

## Crime Scene & Evidence Subcommittees

- [Crime Scene Investigation Subcommittee - International Association for Identification](https://www.theiai.org/crime_scene_investigation_subc.php): Crime scene investigation standards, certification, and evidence collection
- [Digital and Multimedia Evidence Subcommittee - International Association for Identification](https://www.theiai.org/digital_and_multimedia_evidenc.php): Digital evidence examination, authentication, and image tampering detection
- [Footwear and Tire Track Examination Subcommittee - International Association for Identification](https://www.theiai.org/footwear_and_tire_track_examin.php): Footwear and tire track examination standards and forensic databases

## Specialized Forensic Disciplines

- [Forensic Art Subcommittee - International Association for Identification](https://www.theiai.org/forensic_art_subcommittee.php): Forensic art certification, composite drawing, and facial reconstruction
- [Forensic Photography and Electronic Imaging - International Association for Identification](https://www.theiai.org/forensic_photography_and_elect.php): Forensic photography and electronic imaging certification standards
- [General Forensics Subcommittee - International Association for Identification](https://www.theiai.org/general_forensics_subcommittee.php): General forensics certification programs and professional qualifications
